messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick note 1012 1012 A 5-line compact goal template for cross-functional check-ins. Use for 1:1s, pre-OKR reviews, or syncs. Format: 1) Goal (one line), 2) 2 success signals (bulleted), 3) 1 dependency, 4) 1 concrete ask, 5) optional HiringOps line. Drop examples or questions.

Devin (Eng Manager): This looks great. Can we get a Product and an Infra example side-by-side? Managers will copy/paste.

Maya (People Ops): Yup. Two copyable snippets below for quick paste into notes: 

Product example:
Goal: Deliver unified search relevance tuning for embeddings pipeline, launch to 50% of users by 2026-08-01.
Success signals: - Precision@10 improvement >= 4% on benchmark set; - User search satisfaction NPS +3 in pilot cohort.
Dependency: A/B rollout support from infra and updated ranking eval from ML.
Ask: PM to secure analytics event schema by 7/10; Eng to schedule canary.
HiringOps: 1 ML Engineer (ranking) 12 shortlist by 6/24, high risk.

Infra example:
Goal: Reduce embed API p99 from ~420ms to <=320ms by quarter end.
Success signals: - p99 < 350ms sustained for 2 weeks; - end-to-end error rate < 0.1% rolling 30d.
Dependency: KV cache rollout (infra), model quantization PR (ML).
Ask: Infra to commit KV rollout window by 6/10; Eng to add perf regression tests.
HiringOps: 1 SWE (infra) 12 target hire by 7/15, medium risk.

Sasha (PM): Nice. For self-review prompts, can we include a 3-line reflection stanza? Something managers can paste into performance docs.

Maya (People Ops): Sure 12 quick self-review prompt (3 lines):
1) My main contribution this cycle: [one sentence].
2) Evidence / measurable outcomes: [metrics or links].
3) Biggest blocker I want help removing: [one sentence + suggested owner].

Oliver (IC): Can you also add a 30s manager coaching script for check-ins? I run short 1:1s.

Maya (People Ops): Manager 30s script (use verbatim or paraphrase):
- "Nice focus on X. Which metric will show we're winning?"
- "Who needs to unblock you this sprint?"
- "I'll escalate the dependency and follow up on Thursday."

Devin (Eng Manager): Also add a tiny RACI-esque handoff snippet we can paste into tickets: 
R: owner (eng) | A: PM | C: infra, ML | I: security
Handoff notes: perf test link + snapshot, deploy window, rollback plan, contact on-call.

people-ops-bot: Saved template to People Ops drive: https://drive.google.com/compact-goal-templates (folder: compact-goals). Pinning in #people-ops. :pushpin:

Maya (People Ops): Thanks all 12 I'll turn this into a one-pager + a manager checklist (3 bullets: focus, unblock, escalate). @Devin @Sasha DM me any hiring timeline constraints and I'll fold them in before final docs post.
